notes.title: The "3D Escape Room" series is about to release its third installment!
notes.notes:
Good day, players!

Today we're thrilled to announce the next installment in the 3D Escape Room series – [i][b]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/b][/i] is coming soon!

In the game, you inherit your grandfather's legacy - a manor. While exploring this manor, you discover unspeakable secrets hidden within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/a30abc911577bae0355239c095cb0d2bdd28b698.gif[/img]

Driven by curiosity, you open door after door in the ancient mansion, follow clues, solve magnificent puzzles and mechanisms, and attempt to uncover the truth buried beneath this ancient manor.

[list]
[*][b]Mind-Bending Puzzles[/b]

The game includes 16 uniquely styled rooms, over 12 hours of gameplay, hundreds of puzzles and mini-games covering logical reasoning, mathematical calculations, item combinations, and more... Various types of puzzles are perfectly integrated with the story. Use your keen observation and powerful logical reasoning to solve these exciting puzzles and sharpen your wisdom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/d7d8a7b7ac4ad919d4ca6372f9910087d1baaadf.gif[/img]

[*][b]Magical X-Ray Eyepiece[/b]

In our game, you will unlock another visual dimension! Manipulate internal mechanical structures by seeing through object surfaces and discover mysterious clues invisible to the naked eye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/db05fd22ecf8c80d1073ac0aa7179df227704c4d.gif[/img]

[*][b]Breathtaking Graphics & 3D Visuals[/b]

The rooms in the game authentically recreate specific historical eras and local cultural elements from the story's setting. We've combined these beautiful visual elements with puzzle challenges, allowing you to enjoy exploring these exquisite scenes while solving puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/50c06bcada418af120a7f26af4f780ea40bf9c9a.gif[/img]

[/list]

Additionally, enjoy a 20% launch discount for the first two weeks! Don't miss this chance – add to your wishlist now↓↓↓

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612480/3D_Escape_Room_Mystic_Manor/

notes.title: Optimization Patch Released
notes.notes:
Dear Detectives,
The latest optimization patch for [i][b]3D Escape Room: Detective Story[/b][/i] is now live! This update includes the following improvements:

1.Adjusted camera control logic for better operation

2.Fixed operation issues when the game runs above 60 FPS

3.Resolved operation anomalies in Chapter 2 "Butterfly Gears"

4.Fixed valve operation issues in Chapter 4 "Steam Train"

5.Addressed several other known issues

Thank you for your support and feedback! Return to the puzzle world and continue your detective journey.

notes.title: Notice of Release Date Adjustment for "3D Escape Room: Detective Story"
notes.notes:
Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening to all players!

This is the [b]3D Escape Room series development team[/b].

We regret to inform everyone that, after careful consideration, we have decided to postpone the release date to March this year to provide a better gaming experience.

To compensate for the delay, we will release an Early Access version of [b]Detective Story[/b] on the originally scheduled release date for eager players to try.

Thank you for your anticipation of [b]3D Escape Room: Detective Story[/b], and we sincerely apologize again for not being able to release it on time!
